policy_rule: Overnight care is available, but overnight spaces are limited and must be confirmed before the caregiver relies on this option.
expected_agent_behavior: May recommend as an alternate when overnight care is needed; clearly flag capacity confirmation before any application or decision.

policy_rule: Flexible and overnight placements may support rotating schedules, including early mornings, evenings, and overnight coverage.
expected_agent_behavior: May rank highly when a family's required hours cannot be reliably covered by standard centre schedules.

policy_rule: Care is available only during standard operating hours of 07:30-18:30.
expected_agent_behavior: Exclude when required care materially extends beyond operating hours, including overnight coverage.

policy_rule: Infant placements are subject to current waitlist availability; a waitlist does not by itself make the provider ineligible.
expected_agent_behavior: May recommend if other hard constraints are satisfied; surface the waitlist only when it affects timing or requires caregiver action.

policy_rule: Enrollment requires confirmed eligibility through the affiliated employer or workplace program.
expected_agent_behavior: Do not recommend as an eligible provider unless employer eligibility is confirmed; explain the policy conflict and offer valid alternatives.

policy_rule: Children must be at least 12 months old at the time care begins.
expected_agent_behavior: Exclude if the child will be under 12 months on the required start date; otherwise evaluate normally.

policy_rule: This provider is unlicensed and may be considered only when the caregiver has explicitly opted in to unlicensed family childcare and the jurisdiction permits it.
expected_agent_behavior: Exclude by default. Consider only after explicit caregiver opt-in and jurisdiction check; disclose unlicensed status clearly.

policy_rule: Applications may be submitted during pregnancy for future enrollment, subject to later age and availability confirmation.
expected_agent_behavior: May recommend to expecting families planning early; do not imply a placement is guaranteed.
